 assert ref(s['path'])['sha256']==s['sha256'] and Path(s['path']).read_text()==s['text'];source_checks+=1

assert '126 passed' in ready['CPU_tests']['text'] and ready['metric_runtime']['contents']['new_neural_forwards']==0

def functions(p):return {n.name:ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in ast.parse(p.read_text()).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)}
a,b=functions(old),functions(current);assert {k for k in a if a[k]!=b[k]}=={'prepare','review'}
corrected_review=old.read_text().replace('method = f"V171-{endpoint}"','method = f"V172-{endpoint}"');assert functions(current)['review']=={n.name:ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in ast.parse(corrected_review).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)}['review']

original_scores=read(root/'scores-v1.json');normalized_scores=read(root/'scores-method-labels-v2.json')
for k in original_scores:
 if k not in ['rows','summary','native_predictions']:assert original_scores[k]==normalized_scores[k]
for old_rows,new_rows in [(original_scores['rows'],normalized_scores['rows']),(original_scores['summary'],normalized_scores['summary'])]:
 assert len(old_rows)==len(new_rows)
 for old_row,new_row in zip(old_rows,new_rows,strict=True):
  assert old_row['method'].startswith('V171-') and new_row['method']=='V172-'+old_row['method'][5:]
  assert {k:v for k,v in old_row.items() if k!='method'}=={k:v for k,v in new_row.items() if k!='method'}
for identifier,values in original_scores['native_predictions'].items():
 assert len(values)==4
 for label,binding in values.items():assert normalized_scores['native_predictions'][identifier]['V172-'+label[5:]]==binding

reference=read(plan['matched_V171_recipe']['reference_plan']['path']);original=functions(Path(reference['runner']['path']))
assert all(a[k]==original[k] for k in ['train','runtime','resources','tree_equal'])
assert ref(plan['matched_V171_recipe']['objective']['path'])['sha256']==ref(repo/'scripts/nonlocal_residual_objective.py')['sha256']
for endpoint,binding in final['checkpoints'].items():
 assert ref(binding['export']['path'])==binding['export'];state=torch.load(binding['export']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
 module=LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail(**state['module_config']);module.load_state_dict(state['state_dict'],strict=True)
 assert state['component']=='LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail' and model_hash(module)==binding['module_hash'] and model_hash(module.frozen)==binding['frozen_module_hash']
 assert len(module.state_dict())==188 and len(module.network.state_dict())==141 and sum(p.numel() for p in module.network.parameters())==2088906
 assert state['matched_V171_recipe']==plan['matched_V171_recipe'] and ref(state['source']['path'])==state['source']

for cell in bindings['cells']:
 s=summary[cell['kind'],cell['condition'],cell['cohort'],cell['method']];assert f"{s[cell['field']]:.{cell['digits']}f}"==cell['rendered']
for line in bindings['lines']:assert line in text
native=read(final['figures']['path']);assert len(native['images'])==60 and sum(i['triplet'] for i in native['images'])==12
prior=read(plan['prior_figures']['path']);old_map={i['image']['path']:i for i in prior['images']};new_channels=copied_channels=0
for item in native['images']:
 old=old_map[item['source_figure']['path']]
 assert ref(item['image']['path'])==item['image'] and item['source_figure']==old['image'] and item['no_resize']
 assert Path(item['image']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(item['original_image']['path']).read_bytes()
 for field in ['ROI_xywh','anchor','contrast','exposure']:assert item[field]==old[field]
 image=np.asarray(Image.open(item['image']['path']));old_image=np.asarray(Image.open(old['image']['path']));a=dict(np.load(item['case']['arrays']['path']));anchor=np.asarray(item['anchor']).reshape(1,3,1,1);old_panels={p['label']:p for p in old['panels']}
 for panel in item['panels']:
  label=panel['label'];x,y,w,h=panel['xywh'];assert w==h==160
  if label in item['predictions']:
   binding=item['predictions'][label];assert ref(binding['path'])==binding;value=np.load(binding['path']);expected=independent_display(anchor+item['contrast']*(value.astype(np.float64)-anchor),a,item['ROI_xywh'],item['exposure']);new_channels+=expected.size
  else:
   p=old_panels[label];ox,oy,ow,oh=p['xywh'];expected=old_image[oy:oy+oh,ox:ox+ow];copied_channels+=expected.size
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y:y+h,x:x+w],expected)

training=read(root/'training-audit-v1.json');assert training['cached_batches_checked']==1000 and training['final_Adam_states']==141 and training['strict_final_raw_and_EMA_states']==2
quality=read(root/'quality-audit-v1.json');assert quality['input_fingerprints_checked']==6576 and quality['saved_native_RGB_checked']==quality['saved_native_residuals_checked']==72 and quality['ADC_outputs_exact_V169']==144
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
diary=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();assert diary.is_relative_to(repo/'diary') and diary.is_file()
documents=[repo/p for p in ['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md','docs/local-noise-matching.md']]+[diary];links=0
for p in documents:
 for target in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
  if '://' in target or target.startswith('#'):continue
  resolved=(p.parent/target.split('#')[0]).resolve();assert resolved==output or resolved.is_file(),(p,target);links+=1
save(output,dict(status='pass-exact-copies-sources-matched-recipe-endpoints-tables-native-pixels-and-links',publication=ref(index),exact_copies=len(final['copies']),source_texts_checked=source_checks,unchanged_prior_neural_files=95,strict_full_state_endpoint_loads=2,matched_training_function_ASTs=4,rounded_table_cells=len(bindings['cells']),native_figures=60,native_triplets=12,new_RGB_channels_recomputed=new_channels,unchanged_RGB_channels_compared=copied_channels,document_links_checked=links,documents={str(p):ref(p) for p in documents},new_neural_forwards=0,new_source_noise_draws=0,CUDA_initialized=False,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),scope=quality['scope']))
print('PASS',len(final['copies']),'exact copies;',source_checks,'source texts;',len(bindings['cells']),'cells;60 native figures;',new_channels+copied_channels,'RGB channels;',links,'links')
